card.name: Generic nouns after many/several/different
card.fires_on: The vague word that completes a quantity phrase, mostly 'things' after many, several, different or one, and also 'nothing', 'anything', 'which' and 'when' in 'Consider the following when'. It marks a spot where a list or explanation is about to follow.

modes.label: Things after a quantifier
modes.description: The word 'things' or 'thing' follows many, several, different or one, and a list of items comes next.
modes.example: This could be due to several<< things>>, including a typo in any of your

modes.label: Other vague completions
modes.description: Words like nothing, anything or which end a phrase that points to unspecified content.
modes.example: full of sound and fury, signifying<< nothing>>.” Today’s gospel sets things straight.

modes.label: The phrase 'Consider the following when'
modes.description: The word 'when' after 'Consider the following' introduces a list of points in drug label text.
modes.example: Consider the following<< when>> using the information in the below Table
